content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 2.1 (USD 2,000,000/year for three years, take-or-pay, "without reduction or termination rights") is walk-away territory under MINCOMMIT and fails every fallback element. It also directly contradicts § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer made no minimum-volume commitment, and § 7.1's bar on unidentified minimum-use charges.

**Redline (preferred, accepted `ok:true`):** § 2.1 replaced with "Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment and will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term." — one surgical replacement covering both preferred elements, resolving the § 2.1 / § 12.3 conflict, with the fallback (12-month term, 30 days' reduction notice, true-up) offered in the comment.
